create_Flickr_dataset: create a Flickr VisionDataset from an annotation file and image root directory
build_Flickr_with_transforms: build a Flickr dataset instance with custom image and target transforms applied
test_Flickr_getitem: test the Flickr __getitem__ method to return an image and its list of captions
review_Flickr_init: review the Flickr __init__ method that parses annotation files into image-caption pairs
summarize_Flickr_len: summarize the Flickr __len__ method that returns the total number of image-caption entries
